title: Hearty Fried Malaysian Chicken Fried-Rice
description: A rich and dense Malaysian dish featuring deep-fry-tod, perfect for hangover cures and Buddhist temple-friendly.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 pound of chicken breast and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add 1 onion and 3 cloves of garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add 2 inches of ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken seasonings and all-purpose seasoning to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of cooked rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the seasonings.
Add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir to combine with the rice and seasonings.
Push the rice mixture to one side of the skillet.
Add 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of fish sauce to the other side of the skillet and stir to combine.
Scramble 4 eggs in a separate bowl and add to the skillet with the soy sauce and fish sauce mixture.
Stir the egg mixture into the rice mixture and cook until the eggs are fully incorporated.
